# CMakeLists.txt for the MOTU PCI-424 Windows WDF driver.
#
# Build with WDK (Windows Driver Kit) and CMake:
#   cmake -B build -S . -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=wdk_toolchain.cmake
#   cmake --build build
#
# Or use the Visual Studio .vcxproj generated by WDK.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(motu424_driver C)

# WDK paths (adjust as needed)
set(WDK_BASE "C:/Program Files (x86)/Windows Kits/10" CACHE PATH "WDK base path")
set(WDK_VERSION "10.0.22621.0" CACHE STRING "WDK version")

# Include paths
include_directories(
    ${WDK_BASE}/Include/${WDK_VERSION}/km
    ${WDK_BASE}/Include/${WDK_VERSION}/shared
    ../shared
)

# Library paths
link_directories(
    ${WDK_BASE}/Lib/${WDK_VERSION}/km/x64
)

# Driver source files
set(DRIVER_SOURCES
    motu424_wdf.c
    motu424_win_pal.c
    ../shared/motu424_fpga.c
    ../shared/motu424_init.c
    ../shared/motu424_dma.c
)

# Build as kernel driver
add_executable(motu424 ${DRIVER_SOURCES})

# Set output to .sys
set_target_properties(motu424 PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "motu424"
    SUFFIX ".sys"
)

# Compiler flags for kernel driver
target_compile_definitions(motu424 PRIVATE
    _KERNEL_MODE
    NTDDI_VERSION=0x0A000000
    _NT_TARGET_VERSION_WIN10
)

target_compile_options(motu424 PRIVATE
    /kernel
    /GS-
    /Zc:wchar_t
    /utf-8
    /W3
    /O2
)

# Linker flags
target_link_options(motu424 PRIVATE
    /SUBSYSTEM:NATIVE
    /DRIVER
    /ENTRY:DriverEntry
    /NODEFAULTLIB
)

# Link WDF and NTOSKRNL
target_link_libraries(motu424
    wdfdriver
    ntoskrnl
    hal
)

# Copy firmware files alongside the driver
add_custom_command(TARGET motu424 POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../firmware/altera424b.rbf
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/altera424b.rbf
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../firmware/init_sequence.bin
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/init_sequence.bin
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/motu424.inf
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/motu424.inf
)
